parse.title: Wasteland Field
parse.wikitext:
{{Quote | quote=''The waste is watching...''}}
[[File:BattlebgWasteland.png|thumb]]

Wasteland is one of the [[Field Effects]] present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Telluric field.

==General Effects==

===Consumed Hazards===

When placed, Entry Hazards do not have any effect. However, they apply special effects to that side at the end of the turn, and are then destroyed.
* Pokémon in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move or with the Magic Guard Ability are immune to these effects.
* Entry Hazards can still be removed before they act (Defog, Rapid Spin, Court change,...).

====Spikes====

* Grounded Pokémon are damaged for 1/3 max HP per Spike layer.
** ''"The waste swallowed up the spikes!"''
** ''"...Stalagmites burst up from the ground!"''

====Stealth Rock====

* Pokémon are dealt doubled Stealth Rock Damage.
** ''"The waste swallowed up the pointed stones!"''
** ''"...Rocks spewed out from the ground below!"''
*** This translates to the normal damage being 1/4 Max HP and ranging from 6.25% and 100% of the target's Max HP based on its type.

====Sticky Web====

* All Pokémon have their Speed lowered by 4 stages.
** ''"The waste swallowed up the sticky web!"''
** ''"...Sticky string shot out of the ground!"''
*** The ability Mirror Armor prevents the stat drop, but does not reflect it onto the opponent.

====Toxic Spikes====

* Grounded, non-Steel-type and non-Poison Type Pokémon are damaged for 1/8 max HP per Toxic Spike layer.
* Grounded, non-Steel-type and non-Poison Type Pokémon are poisoned if 1 layer was placed, and badly poisoned if 2 layers were placed.
** ''"The waste swallowed up the poison spikes!"''
** ''"...Poison needles shot up from the ground!"''
*** The ability Corrosion does not allow to poison targets through Toxic Spikes.

===Random Status===

Certain moves and abilities have a chance to randomly inflict Burn, Freeze, Paralysis, or Poison on the target.
* ''"The waste joined the attack!"''
** This replaces the moves' normal secondary effects.
** Poison-type or Steel-type Pokémon are immune unless the attacker's ability is Corrosion.
** Pokémon with the abilities Immunity and Shield Dust are immune.
** Pokémon holding the Covert Cloak item are immune.
** Pokémon with the Abilities Toxic Boost or Poison Heal can only be poisoned.
*** Example: The Z-Move Acid Downpour has a 100% chance to inflict a status, therefore each of the 4 status has a 25% chance to be inflicted. However, against a Pokémon with the Ability Toxic Boost, it instead has a 100% chance to poison them.

====Abilities====

* Corrosion → 10% chance when the bearer directly damages its target with a move.
** 2.5% chance per status.
*** This does not display the ''"The waste joined the attack!"'' message.

====Moves====

* Acid Downpour → 100% chance.
** 25% chance per status.
*** Acid Downpour isn't affected by Sheer Force, even though a secondary effect is added.
* Octazooka → 50% chance.
** 12.5% chance per status.
* Gunk Shot, Sludge, Sludge Bomb → 30% chance.
** 7.5% chance per status.
* Sludge Wave → 10% chance.
** 2.5% chance per status.

==Abilities Affected==

===Activated abilities===

* Merciless
* Poison Heal
** ''"[Pokémon] was healed by the poison!"''
* Toxic Boost
** All three only activate if the user is grounded.

===Buffed Abilities===

* Effect Spore, Poison Point and Stench's activation chances are doubled (to 60%, 60%, and 20% respectively).
* Gooey additionally inflicts Poison on activation.
* Liquid Ooze deals double damage on activation.

==Moves Affected==

===Damage Modifiers===

====Moves which receive an attack buff====

* Spit Up → 2x boost.
** ''"BLEAAARGGGGH!"''
* Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud Slap → 1.5x boost, Poison sub-typing.
** ''"The waste was added to the attack!"''
* Power Whip, Vine Whip → 1.5x boost
** ''"The waste did it for the vine!"''
* Gunk Shot, Octazooka, Sludge, Sludge Bomb, Sludge Wave → 1.2x boost.
** ''"The waste joined the attack!"''
*** Acid Downpour is the only move inflicting a random status that does not recieve this boost.

====Moves which receive an attack nerf====

* Bulldoze, Earthquake, Magnitude → 0.25x decrease.
** ''"Wibble-wibble wobble-wobb..."''

===Other moves===

====Buffed Moves====

* Barb Barrage and Venoshock double in power regardless of status.
* Dire Claw's has a 100% chance to inflict a status condition on the target.
** This translates to a 1/3 chance for each status.
* Leech Seed's drains 1/4 HP at the end of each turn.
* Swallow's healing is doubled. If 3 stacks of Stockpile were used, the user also cures itself from non-volatile status conditions. 
* Venom Drench can be activated regardless of status.

===Field-dependent moves & Abilities===

* Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Poison.
* Camouflage changes the user's type to Poison.
* Nature Power becomes Gunk Shot.
* Secret Power may inflict Burn, Paralysis, Freeze, or Poison.
** 7.5% chance per status.
* Shelter halves damage from Poison-type moves.
* Terrain Pulse's type becomes Poison.

==Transition to other Fields==

* The move Tidy Up will terminate this field when used 3 times.
** ''"Some junk was tidied up!"''
** ''"All tidied up!"''

==Items==

* [[Telluric Seed]] boosts Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage and lays Stealth Rocks on both sides of the field.
** ''"Pointed stones float in the air around the battlefield!"''
* [[Shiinotic Crest]]'s drain is doubled to 1/8 Max HP if Shiinotic's opponents are statused.
* [[Zangoose Crest]]'s heal is enabled if Zangoose is grounded, even if it's not poisoned.

==Notes==

* Prior to V14, Octazooka could still lower the target's Accuracy.
